title: Temple Selects tZERO to Operate Its Tokenized Securities ATS
why_it_matters: The agreement separates Temple's trading technology from the regulated operator layer, illustrating how tokenization platforms can enter securities markets by integrating an existing broker-dealer and ATS instead of building those functions internally.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

Temple Selects tZERO to Operate Its Tokenized Securities ATS

Temple Digital Group engaged tZERO Securities as broker-dealer and ATS operator for a planned Canton-based tokenized securities platform; implementation and launch timing remain pending.
